comment: TEMPORARY: remove this file once we depend on a directories-jni / directories
newer than 0.1.4. This is a copy of the metadata added upstream in
https://github.com/coursier/directories-jvm, under the same path, so that the
library ships it itself. As long as we stay on 0.1.4, the metadata has to live
here, or native images throw MissingForeignRegistrationError on Windows.
On JDK 22+, dev.dirs picks its java.lang.foreign-based Windows implementation
(dev.dirs.impl.WindowsForeign, from the JDK 22 multi-release section of the
directories JAR). These are its only downcalls: CLSIDFromString(void*, void*)
and SHGetKnownFolderPath(void*, int, void*, void*), both returning C long,
which is 32-bit on Windows, hence 'int'. Pointers are declared as 'void*':
WindowsForeign builds them with ADDRESS.withTargetLayout(...), which
native-image matches against the canonical 'void*' layout.
